acceptanceCriteria: flows export round-trips qualified link targets with a test.
Docs maintenance resolves a qualified target in its bound repository or reports a named unbound reason, never 'absent'.
body: Found 2026-10-18 by the V1-1675 lane (PR beamfall/corvint#1102, head f58754780, AFU-V1-067..072); recorded in docs/build-log/2026-10-18-V1-1675-e2e-separate-repository.md Limits. Expected: flows export emits links whose targets are qualified ID:PATH, and docs maintenance resolves them in their repository. Actual: export.go skips them and docs maintenance records them as absent root inputs (both recorded spec non-goals).
title: flows export and docs maintenance drop or mis-resolve repository-qualified link targets (ID:PATH)
